001package org.clafer.choco.search;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.assignments.DecisionOperatorFactory;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.decision.Decision;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.decision.SetDecision;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.selectors.values.SetValueSelector;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.selectors.variables.VariableSelector;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.strategy.AbstractStrategy;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
011import org.chocosolver.util.PoolManager;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class RandomSetDecisionStrategy extends AbstractStrategy<SetVar> {
018
019    private final PoolManager<SetDecision> pool;
020    private final VariableSelector<SetVar> varSelector;
021    private final SetValueSelector valSelector;
022    private final Random rand;
023
024    public RandomSetDecisionStrategy(SetVar[] scope, VariableSelector<SetVar> varSelector, SetValueSelector valSelector) {
025        this(scope, varSelector, valSelector, new Random());
026    }
027
028    public RandomSetDecisionStrategy(SetVar[] scope, VariableSelector<SetVar> varSelector, SetValueSelector valSelector, Random rand) {
029        super(scope);
030        this.varSelector = varSelector;
031        this.valSelector = valSelector;
032        this.pool = new PoolManager<>();
033        this.rand = rand;
034    }
035
036    @Override
037    public Decision<SetVar> getDecision() {
038        SetVar variable = varSelector.getVariable(vars);
039        return computeDecision(variable);
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public Decision<SetVar> computeDecision(SetVar s) {
044        if (s == null) {
045            return null;
046        }
047        assert !s.isInstantiated();
048        SetDecision d = pool.getE();
049        if (d == null) {
050            d = new SetDecision(pool);
051        }
052        d.set(s, valSelector.selectValue(s), rand.nextBoolean() ? DecisionOperatorFactory.makeSetForce() : DecisionOperatorFactory.makeSetRemove());
053        return d;
054    }
055}
